meta.scope: non-owner, non-bot review comments on human-owned CLs on main, in scope or not: comments and chars by week written, reviewed CLs by week closed. Roots are the areas: the longest matching path_rules or config/paths.txt area prefix, else the top-level directory; unplaced comments (no inline comment anywhere on their CL) are their own root. Below a root, the dir_limit directories with the most comments are kept; rows are each node's own bucket.
